title: City College: several orders, one supplier, two weeks
question: Did City College place several orders with one supplier within two weeks, each under the bid limit but together over it?
finding: 3 clusters, $438,209 in all, 2023-2025. Largest: Blackhawk Network, Inc., 3 orders from 2023-04-18 to 2023-04-19 totalling $159,338 against a limit of $109,300.
how: Orders dated 2023-2025, excluding construction (CT) and yearly blanket (TP) orders, reductions, and orders whose notes cite a change memo, board resolution, a bid or proposal number, a blanket order or a cooperative purchasing contract (NASPO, CMAS, Sourcewell, the community-college buying consortium and the like); grouped by supplier name; clusters whose orders all carry the same note or the same order number (one award split into budget lines) are left out; a cluster is two or more orders within 14 days of the first, each under the limit, summing to at least the limit. The limit used is the State bid limit printed in school-district contracts of the same year ($109,300 in 2023, $114,500 in 2024, $114,800 in 2025).
limits: Several orders to one supplier are often separate departments, separate grants, or one award split into budget lines (the reports list one line per fund and account). California Community Colleges set the 2025 nonconstruction threshold at $114,800 under Public Contract Code section 20651, up from $114,500 in 2024. Separate rules govern construction. An invoice repeated across order revisions can overstate a group.
